question_part_answerable: partly: the file cannot measure risk per mile driven because it contains no vehicle-miles-traveled exposure; it can show recorded motorist deaths per 1,000 reported crashes.
metric: Annual recorded motorist deaths per 1,000 police-reported NYC crashes
denominator: All eligible police-reported NYC crashes in each crash year, scaled to 1,000 crashes
population: Motorists recorded as killed in police-reported motor-vehicle crashes in NYC, divided by all eligible crashes with a usable crash year in 2013–2025
filters: Crash dates in 2013–2025 inclusive; exclude rows with missing crash year or missing/negative motorist-killed count
initial_data_check: Scoped checks in check_3.csv: 2,132,218 crashes have dates in 2013–2025; each year has rows spanning Jan 1 through Dec 31, including 2025. No missing crash dates, missing motorist-killed values, or negative motorist-killed values were found. Zero motorist deaths occur in most crash rows and are retained in the crash denominator.
data_check_decisions: Keep the full eligible date range and all crashes, including zero motorist deaths; exclude no rows. Missing-year rows cannot be assigned to the requested time trend, but the check found none. No changes to the initial plan.

final_plan.question_part_answerable: Partly. The file cannot measure risk per mile driven because it contains no vehicle-miles-traveled exposure. It can show recorded motorist deaths per 1,000 reported crashes.
final_plan.metric: Annual recorded motorist deaths per 1,000 police-reported NYC crashes
final_plan.denominator: All eligible police-reported NYC crashes in each crash year, scaled to 1,000 crashes
final_plan.population: Motorists recorded as killed in police-reported motor-vehicle crashes in NYC, divided by all reported crashes with a date in 2013–2025 and a nonnegative motorist-killed count
final_plan.filters: Crash dates in 2013–2025 inclusive; zero counts remain in the crash denominator; no rows are dropped by the checks
final_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive; observed dates span Jan 1 to Dec 31 in every year
final_plan.limitations: This crash-normalized measure is not a per-mile risk because miles driven are unavailable. It can change with crash incidence, travel exposure, and reporting as well as fatality risk.
